name: K2-148B

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list K2-148 and K2-148B in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 2536443724641751808 and 2536443724641751680), 1,163 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 7.1e-7: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to K2-148, 1,163 AU away.

radius.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the radius of TIC 423358486 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

mass.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the mass of TIC 423358486 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

temperature.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the effective temperature of TIC 423358486 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

text.card: K2-148B is a star of 3,854 K, bound to K2-148 1,163 AU away.
text.introduction: K2-148B shares its motion through space with K2-148, 1,163 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: K2-148B's orbit around K2-148 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
